title: 原产地证明字段缺项诊断
summary_zh: RCEP附件列明出口商、进口商、商品描述、六位HS编码、原产标准、发票等最低信息，适合做证明文件字段核对。
summary_en: The minimum-information annex identifies parties, goods description, six-digit HS code, origin criterion and invoice information, among other fields for the relevant proof of origin.
tradex_workflow: Extract the certificate fields, compare them with the invoice and order, and ask for any missing or inconsistent field.
cash_effect: Track origin-document readiness before applying a preference to the cost scenario.

原产地证明字段缺项诊断
RCEP附件列明出口商、进口商、商品描述、六位HS编码、原产标准、发票等最低信息，适合做证明文件字段核对。
The minimum-information annex identifies parties, goods description, six-digit HS code, origin criterion and invoice information, among other fields for the relevant proof of origin.
